newsitem.title: USA: NYPA seeks 100,000 bbls 0.3 pct sulphur resid fuel.
newsitem.headline: NYPA seeks 100,000 bbls 0.3 pct sulphur resid fuel.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) is seeking to purchase 100,000 barrels of 0.3 percent sulphur, high-pour No 6 residual fuel oil in a tender issued Friday, a company official said.
The utility requested only fixe-priced bids be submitted by 1100 EST Monday, December 23, he said.
NYPA wants the fuel be delivered to its Astoria, N.Y, facility December 26-30, the official said.
In the New York harbor, spot prices for 0.3 percent sulphur, high-pour No 6 resid were assessed near $22.75 a barrel or 3.61 per million British thermal units (mmBtu).
Swing natgas delivery to the New York City gate was quoted at $5.15/mmBtu in early trading, up from Thursday's $5.05.
